root_native_run_ownership: Parent executes native queue. This helper refuses active receipts, consumes only finalized files, never creates an env/policy or integrations.
receipt_gate: status completed/interrupted/failed AND finished_utc; finalized failure is retained as failure; do not require completed/full primary coverage.

time_contract.output: 1 ms pre-integration native STO; expected episode sample lattice uses receipt actual_episode_start/end, not SimulatorConfig setup horizon
time_contract.fixed_primary: Same frozen selection: three whole cycles plus stance/swing individually; exact 4 HS +3 TO knots
time_contract.partial: Keep requested windows unchanged. Explicit observed intersection and unavailable/partial status; no interpolated extrapolation, invented endpoint or partial promoted complete.
time_contract.quadrature: Trapezoid over exact window boundaries + interior native output timestamps. Saved q and qdot interpolated independently. Positive/negative pieces are sampled quadrature, not exact continuous ODE work.
time_contract.stats: Time-weighted mean/RMS on the quadrature grid; maxima are sampled including boundaries, not certified continuous/RK4-stage maxima.

tracking_contract.position_units: rotations deg, translations m; speeds deg/s and m/s
tracking_contract.served: Saved q_ref/qdot_ref actually supplied by runtime segment/reference governor; no fallback to source IK
tracking_contract.source_raw: Own frozen full-marker model IK, linear position interpolation, distinct from raw healthy dataset IK
tracking_contract.source_filtered: Production KinematicsInterpolator using complete captured filter settings over entire own IK trial, with spline q/qdot; no filter on truncated primary window

vertical_contract.forces: Actual applied left online left_force_y + prescribed measured ground_force2_vy right; online right diagnostic is not applied
vertical_contract.balance: J_left_online + J_right_measured + J_pelvis_ty_reserve - m*g*T = m*(COM_y_dot_end - COM_y_dot_start)
vertical_contract.COM: Only covered exact 7 frozen knots via Velocity-stage FK of saved actual full coordinates and speeds, no constraints/assemble/clamp/Acceleration/Dynamics stage
vertical_contract.parity: Body-mass weighted COM vs native COM with separate position_m/velocity_m_s tolerances; coordinate assignment exact; root translation plus unit pelvis_ty virtual work confirms N
vertical_contract.normalization: Model runtime getTotalMass and model gravity, BW_N=m*(-g_y), same model in each run; work J/kg; no averaged reference model mass

reserve_contract.force_impulses: N*s for translations, Nm*s for rotations, signed/absolute/positive>=0/negative<=0
reserve_contract.work: Actual saved generalized force/torque times actual saved generalized speed; signed/absolute/positive/negative J and J/kg
reserve_contract.muscle_fraction: Per-DOF integral(abs tau_muscle)/(integral(abs tau_muscle)+integral(abs tau_reserve)); undefined when denominator zero; cannot mix translational N and rotational Nm
reserve_contract.legacy: Recorded recruitment norm/share mix force and torque, retained only as labelled diagnostics; equilibrium_failures is a handled equilibrium-attempt fallback count, not final SO failure or recovery proof

SEA_contract.identities: Independent existing audited PI/spring/rotor derivative laws, actual XML properties and effective controller snapshot; preserve serialization-derived pointwise bounds, not widened posthoc tolerance
SEA_contract.scope: All native rows + native rows inside fixed primary window; no interpolated non-linear identities at boundaries
SEA_contract.clamps: Applied command near abs(u)>=0.999 and exactly abs(u)==1; u_unclipped=tau_cmd_raw/Fopt and actual clipping; cascade PI integral/antiwindup; plugin PI integral and motor torque500Nm separately. No policy-action clipping because no NN loaded.

biological_contract: Record observed MTP and every XML joint range and out-of-range sample counts, reserve/muscle per-DOF stats; no invented clinical pass gate, physiological validation or global no-saturation claim.
prefix_contract: P4_A1 and AB06_control compare every available decoded native STO column/value/time against old paired physical prefix exactly. File-header nRows/hash are different. Preserve old AB06 failed899 callback despite saved physical9s.

plots.implementation: Root plot/plotter.py figure01-06 direct calls plus frozen prescribed rawIK/healthy/actual figure07 adapter; no --mlp/main discovery/inference, strict served figure06
plots.partial: Only entire frozen reference cycles inside all plot supports; excluded cycles recorded; requested receipt status and metric coverage in figure label
plots.visual_review: Rendering manifest remains pending until independent visual review, no visual PASS claimed

aggregate_gate: Only all18 finalized per-case metrics bound to exact current receipt+protocol; aggregate descriptive, statuses/partial coverage retained.

commands.all_unanalyzed: same helper --all --plots after all18 final; refuses existing metrics

verification_so_far: AST parse only; runtime diagnostics/FK/plot main deliberately not executed before run completion. Portable source paths and Windows DLL shim are retained; Windows native execution not tested.
